content: Store abacavir solution or tablets at room temperature, ensuring they are kept away from light and moisture. The abacavir solution can also be stored in the refrigerator, but it should not be frozen. Over time, the solution may change color from clear or yellow to brown; this is expected. Do not store this medication in the bathroom. Avoid flushing medications down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. Properly dispose of this product when it is expired or no longer needed. This information was last revised in August 2024.
